title: rhododendron nudiflorum var. polyandrum
intro: Rhododendron nudiflorum var. polyandrum, commonly known as the polyandrous wintergreen, is a variety of shrub that belongs to the rhododendron family. It is a plant used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant is said to exhibit therapeutic actions, such as analgesic and antispasmodic effects, which may help alleviate pain and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Rhododendron nudiflorum var. polyandrum include polyphenolic compounds, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
